specClauses.wording: Implement internal process execution with argument arrays, cancellation, environment scoping and diagnostic redaction; keep helper APIs internal.
Paths containing spaces and Unicode reach javac and child applications unchanged on each advertised OS.
Cancellation terminates owned children and leaves reusable previous outputs intact.

rootRulings.decision: Own all Process instances launched by this component, including in-flight launches; cancellation terminates and joins each plus drainers. Descendant enumeration is not a containment proof; forced parent death and escaped descendants remain unqualified.
rootRulings.reason: Exact internal task/F04 and JDK/native source distinguish direct lifecycle from stronger OS containment
rootRulings.costIfWrong: Native adapter and lifecycle/oracle rework; no premature full credit

rootRulings.decision: SDK-owned diagnostics redact synthetic secrets from argv/env/stdin and failures; raw child protocol and JDK TRACE/JFR/OS observation are explicitly separate. Do not exclude secret argv tests.
rootRulings.reason: Diagnostic redaction requirement does not promise OS secrecy

rootRulings.decision: A shipped nonexported module implementation exercised by SDK-owned private packaged consumer can meet the internal capability task. Keep current provider seed default; no forced bootstrap rewrite.
rootRulings.reason: Task explicitly internal APIs; no public CLI required

rootRulings.decision: Defer transport selection until OP02 actual native Java/javac Unicode observations
rootRulings.reason: Existing launcher transport evidence does not prove new process route

authority.rule: Binding specification wins. Final12-task plan supersedes historical OP02 eight-file allowance; OP02A/B/C each3files, checkpoint after OP02C.

trustRule: Capture checks the two exact sibling manifest digests against this contract before any launch. Proof readers must anchor the reviewed contract digest outside producer-selected proof data; rehashing a reduced fixture/expected inventory does not change trusted requirements. Final source/class digest freeze is a separately reviewed OP07 extension, not an observation selected as its own expectation.

architecture.current: Same private evaluator remains. Provider-only seed and own-root launcher are accepted predecessors, not generic process capability.
architecture.proposed: Single owned internal Java process component in existing nonexporting SDK module; nested internal request/result/state types; no public Process facade, execute/debug CLI or duplicate evaluator.
architecture.ownership: Direct Process objects created by owner. Reserve launch slot before start; publish direct handle before use; cancellation closes admission and waits in-flight slots. Child may run before ProcessBuilder.start returns: this is not suspended creation or OS containment.
architecture.cancellation: Close stdin, concurrently drain bounded outputs, destroy then bounded grace/force, observe actual exit and join drainers. Preserve interrupt after cleanup; timeout/cleanup failure stays non-success. Never claim kill from future cancellation.
architecture.environment: Immutable per-operation copy, ProcessBuilder-local env, explicit cwd, platform case handling, no caller environment/cwd/Console encoding mutation. Reject malformed values and Java option injection.
architecture.argv: Arrays with exact selected executable identity, no shell concatenation. Actual Windows/Linux java/javac/app Unicode must be captured; inherited launcher proof is not proof of new process route.
architecture.redaction: SDK diagnostics use error categories/operation labels rather than raw request/Throwable messages. Test synthetic tagged secrets even if production discourages secret argv. Bound child data separately; do not automatically dump stdout/stderr into errors. Known-secret rendering must handle split chunks. Unknown transformations are not universally redactable.
architecture.telemetry: TRACE/JFR/OS argument observation is a separate explicit boundary. Base64 is not secrecy. Stronger secrecy requires a reviewed transport/telemetry contract; cannot be solved merely by excluding secret tests.
architecture.descendants: Snapshot observation may diagnose, not define or prove complete ownership. Dynamic descendants, escaped daemons, forced parent death and VM crash guarantees require separate native qualification if demanded by accepted predicate.

limits.timeouts: Query20s/owned operation120s existing maximum; proposed grace1s then force/join using remaining <=5s cleanup reserve. Bounds include cleanup; failure if not observed terminal.
limits.linux: Networknone/read-onlyroot/capdropALL/noNewPrivileges/CPU2/memory512MiB+swap512MiB/pids64/core0/inner25s/aggregate180s/reserve40s. Split finite groups, never raise caps silently.
limits.profiles: JDK21x64Windows/Linux; Windows printableASCII JDKhome, semantic256tokens/32768UTF16 and complete encoded native30000UTF16 guard. Linux C.UTF-8 and measured case-enabled9p/NTFS, not ext4. Windows isolated offline/Java25/macOS/ARM64/public distribution/global selector remain OPEN.

rules: Reserve before OS start; close admission on cancellation/close; wait all in-flight slots.
Publish/retain Process immediately after start before caller access; recheck cancellation even when start returned late.
Close stdin; drain both pipes concurrently within fixed byte bounds; overflow is non-success and triggers cleanup.
Destroy, wait up to1s then force if alive; observe exit and join all workers within remaining deadline and <=5s reserve.
Idempotent cancel/close; cleanup errors remain explicit; restore interrupted status after cleanup.
No success on outer-guard intervention; all owned handles and workers must have independently observed terminal state.

cli.contract: Absolute path to this versioned contract; sibling source-map.json and fixtures.json digest-bound before launch.
cli.output: Fresh absolute D-owned host directory; reject existing/nonempty root, reparse alias or path outside assigned task scratch.

exitCodes.0: Complete capture with all mandatory rows and observations; does not mean product parity passed.
exitCodes.1: Validation/capture/cleanup failure with retained failure receipt; never publish complete capture.
exitCodes.2: CLI usage failure before any launch.

fixture.offline: Clear package sources; all restore/build inputs local and explicitly recorded. Separate offline build before --no-build run. No implicit build/restore/network during capture.
fixture.resolution: Resolve dotnet/project/mode/request tokens to pinned executable, staged absolute project, fixed cohort mode and prelaunch request path; retain the literal final --. Append request.argv according to payloadRule. No unexpanded placeholder token is passed.
fixture.apiHarness: For R06/R07/R08 the run command only hosts the fixture. Record child ProcessStartInfo/ArgumentList invocation separately; do not attribute API wait or kill behavior to SDK Command/ProcessReaper.

payloadRule.assembly: Resolve the fixed command prefix tokens first, then append every request.argv token unchanged as a distinct argument after the final --. In R03 request.argv is exactly fixtures.corpus.argv. All SDK-command cohorts use this vector rule; other cases may have an empty payload array.
payloadRule.controlGrammar: After dotnet consumes its first --, fixture Main receives exactly --mode, mode, --request, absoluteRequestPath, --, then payload. Validate the first five tokens positionally; the fifth token is the fixture delimiter. Every token after it is payload, even empty strings, --mode, --request or --. Never scan payload for controls.
payloadRule.observation: Fixture derives received payload from its actual Main(string[] args) suffix after index4, and emits independently computed tokens, Unicode scalar arrays and UTF16 lengths. It reads request.json only for requested comparison/configuration, never as the received observation.
payloadRule.transport: Use the selected native SDK process argument array, no shell joining. Record the entire resolved actual SDK argv vector separately from the requested payload and the child-observed payload. An API-harness child does not replace this sdk-command observation.

jdk.transport: UNRESOLVED pending OP02C: record exact native argv and codepoints for actual java/javac, child cwd and result. No inherited launcher equivalence assertion.

wire.framing: One strict UTF8 JSON object plus LF. Exact same positional control grammar as native fixture. Request engine jdk-probe, mode from frozen enum, rowId from corresponding boundary group. No capture status or outer guard/network/container assertions.
wire.actors: actor is {kind:jdk-probe,pid:actual probe PID}; receivedPayload independently observes actual main suffix; environment and parentEnvironment maps belong to probe. Each operations element owns one actual Process and its independently observed child streams/payload. Never infer driver or JDK internal thread joins. Final result.observationActors is exactly {outerProcess:driver-owned-outer,parentEnvironment:driver,payload:jdk-probe,apiOperations:jdk-probe-child-operations} for these rows.
wire.operationWire: Use fixtureStdout.apiOperation field semantics with probe as parentActorPid. Streams use unchanged embeddedBytes. handles additionally records onExitFutureCanceled and aliveAfterFutureCancel for the separate hold-child lifecycle operation. Child protocol schema dotj.owned-process.probe-child/1 contains pid, receivedPayload, cwd, environment and stdin embeddedBytes; independently parsed and bound to Process PID.
wire.paths: Probe artifacts only under request.cwd. java-argv uses selected pinned java and compiled ProbeChild. javac-unicode selects pinned javac, writes fixed UnicodeApp.java in Unicode cwd, compiles with --release21/UTF8/proc:none to cwd/classes, then launches pinned sibling java with cwd/classes plus probe classpath. Tool descriptors for java/javac must be in request.inputs, all verified before launch.
wire.bounds: Each child <=20s including cleanup; entire probe uses request deadline <=120s. Both pipes drained concurrently <=1MiB each, stdin<=65536, categorical errors only, actual observed exit and worker joins. Every launch uses bounded JVM options, explicit child environment and cwd; no global configuration mutation.
wire.telemetry: jdk-trace configures java.util.logging programmatically in the probe before ProcessBuilder creation and retains trace.log under cwd; jdk-jfr programmatically records enabled jdk.ProcessStart events and retains recording.jfr under cwd. telemetry is array of relative path/bytes/sha256 plus observed synthetic argv exposure boolean and event commands where applicable. These are raw telemetry separate from SDK diagnostics.
wire.failure: errors nonempty/expectedOuterExitCode nonzero means failed probe. Missing evidence is null or explicit failure, never manufactured terminal facts. Actual transport codepoint differences are observations, not normalized success/parity claims.
wire.rootRuling: task147-op02b-wire-native-ruling-v1.json; prospective five-file OP02B inventory, no product credit
wire.transportComparison: Mandatory {roundTrip:boolean,differences:[{index,requested,observed}]} compares requested argv with independently received Main suffix; missing tokens use null. Each child operation with childObservation has analogous comparison against actual selected command payload. Measured loss is a valid boundary observation; roundTrip=false is never semantic parity. U01 remains pending OP02C root checkpoint; no C# or product rule weakened.

jdk.terminalTransportNegative: Narrow inventory-only allowance: only javac-unicode operations exactly native-javac EXITED/exit0 followed by compiled-application IO_FAILED/actual observed nonzero exit may retain absent child protocol. Require exact retained nonzero PID/startIdentity, terminal+observedExit and matching exitCode, all three started/closed/terminal/joined/error-null workers, both available/hash-bound bounded raw streams, monotonic end<=deadline, actual outer expectedExit matching observed probe exit, and exact sole errors [{category:IO_FAILED,actorPid:probe PID}]. Every other operation/error/mode/failure still fails. Raw disposition/errors/bytes never rewritten; this is measured transport failure, never product parity, lifecycle success or T4 eligibility. Ordinary row sealer and aggregate boundary validator use identical predicate.

requestFields.argv: ordered string array, exact UTF16 and Unicode scalar arrays retained
requestFields.environment: Exactly {baseline:{values: complete case-preserving string-to-string map}, set: string-to-string map, remove: string array}; environmentWire defines validation/application. Whole exact requestSha256 binds all values; no secondary baseline descriptor/hash.
requestFields.secrets: synthetic sentinel labels and values from fixtures only
requestFields.limits: exact typed bounds and platform caps
requestFields.effectsRoots: explicit owned staging, prior SDK, source and sibling sentinel paths
requestFields.argvCodepoints: Mandatory scalar arrays computed from requested payload argv before launch; compared to independently observed result.argvCodepoints.
requestFields.argvUtf16Lengths: Mandatory UTF16 code-unit lengths computed from requested payload argv before launch.

resultFields.platform: actual native OS/arch/locale and tool version evidence
resultFields.invocation: resolved actual executable argv cwd environment and input digest
resultFields.exitCode: actual integer only when exit observed; otherwise null
resultFields.handles: launchSlot, pid, startIdentity, retained, cancel/destroy/force events, observedExit, exitCode, terminal
resultFields.workers: stdin/stdout/stderr started, closed, terminal, joined, errorCategory
resultFields.streams: Raw tested-process stdout/stderr byte length sha256 path and truncation boolean. For native reference fixture rows these are driver-observed outer streams: fixture stdout JSON remains stdout.bin and API-child streams stay embedded. Product/helper rows retain tested-process stream semantics.
resultFields.diagnostics: SDK-owned categorical diagnostic bytes and redaction checks, separate from raw streams
resultFields.outerGuard: used boolean, actions, observed terminal; intervention forces failed capture
resultFields.container: identity, caps, exit, removal/absence observation; null on Windows
resultFields.argvCodepoints: Mandatory ordered arrays of integer Unicode scalars derived independently from received payload argv, excluding fixture controls; never copied from request argv. Empty token is an empty scalar array.
resultFields.argvUtf16Lengths: Mandatory per-received-payload-token UTF16 code-unit lengths, including zero for an empty token.
resultFields.parentEnvironmentBefore: Complete actual process-owning caller environment map before launch. For native reference fixture rows this is the driver; nested fixtureObservation parent snapshots separately belong to fixture. Product rows retain the actual tested helper caller as actor, not an unrelated outer Python driver.
resultFields.parentEnvironmentAfter: Complete actual same-caller environment map after cleanup; equals its before snapshot. For native fixture rows driver snapshots never substitute fixture/API-child maps. Product helper nonmutation still requires its actual caller snapshots.
resultFields.fixtureObservation: Verified subordinate fixtureStdout object for native reference fixture rows; null for engines without this fixture. Embedded API-child facts remain nested and actor-scoped.
resultFields.observationActors: Explicit actor map defined by fixtureToDriver.actorMap; prevents driver parent snapshots or outer streams from being mistaken for fixture/API-child facts.
resultFields.jdkProbeObservation: Conditional: required verified complete subordinate JDK wire object on jdk-probe rows, null otherwise. fixtureObservation stays null for JDK rows. Raw outer streams remain driver-observed.

effectsFields.before: Mandatory object with exactly source, priorSDK, siblings, staging keys; each is a complete relative-path map to type,bytes,sha256 descriptors, captured before operation.
effectsFields.after: Mandatory object with exactly source, priorSDK, siblings, staging keys; each has same inventory shape as before. source/priorSDK/siblings equal their respective before maps for preservation cases.
effectsFields.priorSdkSmoke: actual invocation streams exit after failure/cancel when required; not just hashes

protocol.aggregateRule: After completion, reference request.json becomes the row envelope defined by requestRetention, retaining exact prelaunch request bytes as base64. Product observation.json uses the same envelope. Four per-row files remain unchanged. Boundary observation.json contains ordered per-mode envelopes with raw stream offsets and actual invocations; all modes mandatory.
protocol.framing: UTF8 JSON, duplicate keys forbidden, finite numbers only; raw outer stdout/stderr unmodified. Native fixture stdout follows fixtureStdout subordinate schema, then fixtureToDriver constructs the final observation. Request byte retention remains requestRetention unchanged. Fixture READY events are subordinate actor-scoped event records. File descriptors carry relative path, byte length and lowercase SHA256.
protocol.channels: Raw child protocol and TRACE/JFR/OS data retained in explicitly separate objects, never replayed as SDK-owned diagnostics. Only synthetic secret fixtures allowed.
protocol.guard: Outer owned-process guard must record direct processes/container and terminal cleanup. It protects the capture host only. Any guard cleanup needed for a product case makes that case/capture non-success; retain evidence and do not publish a complete proof.
protocol.normalization: Only explicit product names, fixture roots, timestamps and platform artifact representations may be compared with reviewed mappings. Never normalize exit status, codepoint loss, effects, missing warning, cancellation or telemetry exposure.

requestRetention.wireFile: Before launch request.json contains only the exact UTF8 request bytes R, with duplicate keys forbidden. The fixture reads R before completing; capture must retain R in memory until it writes the final envelope after fixture termination.
requestRetention.hashDomain: requestSha256 = lowercase SHA256(base64-decode(requestBytesBase64)), over the exact prelaunch bytes R, including whitespace and optional final newline. requestBytesLength = len(R). Result and effects requestSha256 must equal this digest. No parse/reserialize normalization is permitted.
requestRetention.roundTrip: Reader strictly base64-decodes R, validates its length/hash and UTF8 JSON, then uses that parsed object as the request. There is no separately authoritative nested request object.
requestRetention.finalEnvelopeDigest: The descriptor in the aggregate/proof hashes final envelope file bytes E independently, after result insertion. No digest of E is stored inside E. The graph is aggregate -> E -> R and result/effects -> SHA256(R), never E -> SHA256(E).

environmentWire.validation: All three environment members and baseline.values are mandatory, even when empty. baseline has exactly values, never path/sha256/bytes. JSON duplicate keys forbidden; case-distinct keys remain distinct in JSON. Names are nonempty strings without NUL or =; values are strings without NUL; remove entries obey name rules. Reject malformed Unicode. No implicit ambient-map merge.
environmentWire.application: Create a child-local environment from baseline.values, apply remove entries in array order, then apply set entries in ordinal Unicode-scalar key order (JSON member order never controls precedence). Use the same ordinal order to apply baseline keys. Values are not shell expanded. On Linux names compare case-sensitively; on Windows the native environment compares names case-insensitively using ordinal-ignore-case semantics. Later applied equivalent names replace the value; retain the spelling of the later entry in the requested map, but record actual OS-returned spelling independently.
environmentWire.caseCorpus: Dotj_Case and dotj_case both remain in the request. Linux expects two distinct names; Windows application collapses their equivalence class in the specified order. Do not claim both survive Windows or normalize away the observed key spelling/value. Native API/OS-added entries are retained as actual observations and explicitly compared, not rewritten to the requested map.
environmentWire.actors: Driver applies request.environment to the launched fixture/SDK process using its child-only start configuration. Fixture observes its own actual environment independently. For an API child, fixture applies that same explicit environment to the child-only ProcessStartInfo and separately observes any child-reported environment; its own environment is the parent of that API child. Driver parent snapshots describe the driver, not the fixture.
environmentWire.nonmutation: Neither driver nor fixture may mutate process-global environment, current directory or console encoding to configure a child. Child cwd and UTF8 I/O encoding are configured per child/stream; snapshot/report actors separately.
environmentWire.captureSetup: New capture driver and native fixtures run under a complete controlled minimal environment: only required OS/toolchain paths/settings and synthetic sentinels from a reviewed per-profile allowlist. Never copy unrelated host environment/credentials into baseline or snapshots. Full before/after maps are independently observed from the actual controlled caller, not substituted from request. SDK-command route final parent snapshots belong to capture driver; API-harness route additionally records fixture-as-API-parent snapshots independently. Preserve historical failed private receipts without dumping/publishing host environment. This harness setup rule does not prohibit secret argv fixtures or weaken product diagnostic redaction.

fixtureStdout.framing: Exactly one UTF8 JSON object followed by one LF on fixture stdout on normal fixture completion, including exit17; no BOM, leading text or multiple JSON values. Strict duplicate-key/nonfinite-number rejection. Fixture stderr remains separate raw bytes. A missing/malformed observation is a driver capture failure, never a fabricated observation.

requiredFields.requestSha256: lowercase SHA256 of exact prelaunch request file bytes R, before parsing; same retained R as final driver envelope
requiredFields.actor: {kind:reference-fixture,pid:positive integer}; PID belongs to fixture itself, not driver or API child
requiredFields.receivedPayload: {argv:string array,argvCodepoints:integer scalar arrays,argvUtf16Lengths:integer array}; independently derived from actual Main payload suffix
requiredFields.environment: {values:complete actual fixture environment string-map}; not copied from requested baseline
requiredFields.parentEnvironmentBefore: complete actual fixture environment map before API-child operations; actor is fixture, not driver
requiredFields.parentEnvironmentAfter: complete actual fixture environment map after API-child cleanup; equals fixture before snapshot
requiredFields.apiOperations: array of apiOperation objects below; empty for SDK-command-only modes
requiredFields.events: array of {kind:READY|EXIT_OBSERVED|CLEANUP,rowId:string,actorPid:integer}; observations of fixture/API lifecycle only, never outer capture claims
requiredFields.expectedOuterExitCode: 17 for exit17;0 for successfully completed other fixture modes; nonzero for fixture failure. This is declared intent, not proof of actual outer exit; driver independently records actual process exit.
requiredFields.errors: array of {category:string,actorPid:integer}; fixture-owned bounded error categories only; no raw request/secrets or fabricated driver diagnostics

apiOperation.identity: id unique within fixture; parentActorPid equals fixture actor.pid; childPid is actual child PID or null on failed start. All handle/worker facts refer only to this API operation.
apiOperation.invocation: {executable:absolute string,argv:string array,cwd:absolute string,environment:environmentWire}; actual child-only ProcessStartInfo values, not outer SDK invocation
apiOperation.outcome: disposition uses final process-disposition enum but describes only API child; exitCode is actual observed child exit or null; handles/workers/timing use existing field definitions scoped to API child. Cancellation of wait is recorded separately from destroy/force/actual exit.
apiOperation.streams: Exactly {stdout:embeddedBytes,stderr:embeddedBytes}; bytes are raw API-child bytes, not fixture outer stdout JSON. No invented empty bytes when unavailable: {base64:null,bytes:null,sha256:null,available:false}; otherwise available:true and embeddedBytes checks mandatory.
apiOperation.childObservation: null when no child protocol observation exists, otherwise {pid,receivedPayload,cwd,environment:{values}} independently reported by child and bound to API child identity; never filled from request.

embeddedBytes.rule: If available=true, strict base64 decodes exact bytes B, bytes=len(B), sha256=lowercase SHA256(B). Apply existing stream byte caps. Parsed content does not replace B. Driver/reader materializes B in memory from these fields; no extra per-row files are required. Retain outer stdout.bin/stderr.bin unchanged.

fixtureStdout.ownership: Fixture emits no CAPTURE_COMPLETE/status, effects snapshot, outer streams descriptor, outerGuard, network or container assertions. It does not emit the final dotj.owned-process.observation/1 object.

fixtureToDriver.scope: This merge applies only to native reference fixture rows. It does not redefine product/helper observation ownership: product rows still report the tested owned process and its actual caller, with explicit actor attribution.
fixtureToDriver.verify: Driver retains all outer stdout/stderr bytes first, parses the single fixture observation from raw stdout only after observing process termination, verifies schema/rowId/mode/requestSha256/actor identities, embedded byte hashes and independent received-payload consistency. A valid exit17 observation plus observed actual exit17 is complete reference capture, not a successful child exit.
fixtureToDriver.preserve: Final result.fixtureObservation contains the exact parsed subordinate object from outer stdout; descriptor binding to outer stdout bytes preserves its raw representation. Never flatten API-child streams/lifecycle into outer fields, never replace stdout.bin JSON with embedded API-child stdout.
fixtureToDriver.driverFacts: Final invocation/exit/handles/workers/timing/streams refer to driver-owned outer SDK/fixture process. Final parentEnvironmentBefore/After describe the driver process. Driver alone records complete effects snapshots, raw outer streams descriptors, actual exit, guard actions, network/container evidence, and creates retained request/final envelope. Fields must come from real driver observations, never defaults supplied by fixture.
fixtureToDriver.actorMap: observationActors is exactly {outerProcess:driver-owned-outer,parentEnvironment:driver,payload:reference-fixture,apiOperations:reference-fixture-child-operations} for reference fixture rows. Nested fixture.parentEnvironmentBefore/After belong to fixture; nested childObservation.environment belongs to API child. Other engines set payload to product-child or jdk-probe and fixtureObservation:null.
fixtureToDriver.failure: Driver sets CAPTURE_FAILED for malformed/missing subordinate object, mismatched binding, unavailable mandatory evidence, guard intervention or cleanup failure. Fixture cannot declare capture completion. expectedOuterExitCode must match independently observed actual exit; a nonzero intentional fixture code does not alone make the capture fail.

platformAdapter.entry: capture_windows.py or capture_linux.py: run_capture(contract, fixtures, output)
platformAdapter.arguments: Validated parsed contract and fixtures dictionaries, absolute fresh D-owned output pathlib.Path. Common driver creates output immediately before module import. Adapter must not create/reuse another output root.
platformAdapter.responsibility: Adapter selects pinned tools, validates source-map/tool/fixture digests and platform identity, enforces controlled caller environment, owns guard/native launch/effects facts, calls common capture_row to seal rows; never reads unrelated host secrets. Common driver does not launch native processes.
platformAdapter.return: {status:CAPTURE_COMPLETE|CAPTURE_FAILED, referenceRows:{frozen rowId: descriptor of final request.json}, boundaryGroups:{frozen groupId: descriptor of observation.json}, inputs:{contract:descriptor,fixtures:descriptor,sourceMap:descriptor}, platform:windows|linux}. Descriptors use path/bytes/sha256, paths relative to output; inputs are retained exact byte copies under output/inputs. Common driver verifies complete row/group inventories, file descriptors and envelopes, all required fields. Four frozen reference aggregates remain mandatory; capture-receipt.json is additional coordinator receipt.
platformAdapter.failure: Missing module or any unavailable required evidence produces retained capture-failure.json and exit1. No empty complete receipt; failed artifacts remain. CLI exit2 reserved argparse usage failures.
platformAdapter.boundaryWire: Boundary observation.json is {rowId:groupId,status:CAPTURE_COMPLETE|CAPTURE_FAILED,modes:[ordered row-envelope/1]}. Per-mode result.streams descriptors include offset into shared stdout.bin/stderr.bin, plus bytes/sha256/truncated. effects.json is {modes:{mode:effects/1}}; each per-mode result.effects descriptor binds the whole file and selects its mode by request.mode. Request.json retains the ordered exact prelaunch request byte envelopes. No invented terminal fields for unsupported SDK signal/parent-death boundaries.
platformAdapter.aggregates: Each platform capture supplies reference/observations-<platform>.json, reference/manifest.json and reference/summary.json. Opposite-platform observations join at OP02C; the full frozen four-aggregate set remains required at checkpoint. Common driver retains exact inputs/contract.json, inputs/fixtures.json, inputs/source-map.json before adapter import.
platformAdapter.preparation: After common validates exact contract/fixtures/source-map hashes and creates fresh strict D output, optional Linux prepare_output(output) enables that still-empty directory using separately retained assigned task scratch guard receipts, verifies actual case-sensitive state, then common retains inputs and calls run_capture. Productive captures independently verify two case-distinct names inside selected native mount. fsutil exit alone is insufficient.

sdkBoundary.selection: Only engine sdk-command, rowId windows-telemetry-ownership or linux-telemetry-ownership matching platform, mode sdk-parent-death or sdk-signal. Ordinary SDK fixture rows unchanged.
sdkBoundary.subordinate: Conditional sdkBoundaryObservation in final result; fixtureObservation and jdkProbeObservation null for these exact boundary modes. For MEASURED modes raw outer stdout is the exact subordinate JSON plus LF; raw SDK target stdout/stderr remain separately embedded observation evidence.

fields.platform: {os:windows|linux,arch:x64,profile:CREATE_NO_WINDOW|owned-container-POSIX}; Windows N/A additionally nativeVersion and creationFlags integer 0x08000004 bound to actual host/profile
fields.action: {kind:TerminateProcess|SIGKILL|SIGTERM,identity:exact retained SDK parent,requestedNanos,completedNanos,succeeded:true}; Windows death uses TerminateProcess, Linux death SIGKILL, Linux signal SIGTERM
fields.observerCleanup: {actions:[{kind,identity:exact observed target,requestedNanos,completedNanos,succeeded:true}],terminalObserved:true,workersJoined:true}; observer cleanup is separately attributed and never SDK propagation

sdkBoundary.terminalState: {observedTerminal:boolean,exitCode:integer|null,method:actual native observation method,observedNanos:monotonic integer}; exitCode null if unobserved. Parent final and target after cleanup require observedTerminal; target before cleanup may remain alive.
sdkBoundary.availabilityException: Only Windows sdk-signal under actual CREATE_NO_WINDOW profile with source-mapped POSIX-only signal behavior may be NOT_APPLICABLE. sdkParent,targetChild,action,observerCleanup and final result handles/workers/timing/exitCode/invocation/argvCodepoints/argvUtf16Lengths are null; launched false, disposition NOT_APPLICABLE, outerGuard {used:false,actions:[],observedTerminal:null}; empty raw streams. This is inventory completeness, never fabricated lifecycle success. All other unavailable/missing/failed modes fail.
sdkBoundary.measurement: Actual pinned dotnet run --no-build --reference-child ROW wait-cancel-force -- PAYLOAD supplies SDK parent and independently observed READY target. Intentional exact-owned parent action differs from outer guard intervention. Before-observer-cleanup facts precede all observer cleanup actions. All launched actors and workers require actual terminal/join observations; unknown/timeout/overflow/outer-guard intervention fails capture.
sdkBoundary.scope: Stronger parent-death/descendant/telemetry guarantees remain unqualified under D1/D2. No product or batch credit from boundary records.

linuxNativeReceipt.raw: Linux observer stdout is exact raw nativeReceipt JSON plus LF, retained byte-for-byte in mode slice; sdkBoundaryObservation.nativeReceipt is strict parsed identical JSON. Windows raw observer stdout remains exact sdkBoundaryObservation. Host-derived facts never replace raw native stdout.
linuxNativeReceipt.derivation: Field-for-field validator binds parent/target identity to actual proc-startticks, parent shell wait status/time, exact action times, target READY and before/after native states, and separate observer cleanup facts. Native clock is Linux /proc/uptime monotonic nanoseconds; outer driver timing has its own native observer clock, Windows ownership timestamps remain host monotonic. Actual SDK child stdout/stderr separately embedded/hash-bound as targetStreams and READY parses from actual target stdout.

proofEnvelope.keying: referenceRows/productRows/boundaryGroups maps keyed by frozen IDs; sources by repo-relative path; artifact.classes by full JAR entry. readers uses exactly read_proof.py,evidence_schema.py,seed/proof_reader.py and seed/inherited/{read_proof.py,compare.py,corpus.py,native_lock.py,inherited_models.py}, corresponding to readerBundleMapping after removing leading reader/. JSON Pointer applies to the materialized projection described below.
proofEnvelope.controls: baseProof,currentReader,scopeSha256,60 exact negative IDs and execution receipts; final proof references nonfinal base to avoid cyclic hash. Old154 scope remains separate.
proofEnvelope.completeness: Exact fixed key sets from fixtures, immutable reviewed final class set from OP07, actual byte hashes. Missing keys, unexpected members, duplicate JSON keys, unresolved observed digests, failed receipts or wrong-row objects reject.

rowProjection.platform: Row platform is the request platform enum, independently required to match the frozen row ID/profile.
rowProjection.request: Strictly decode retained R from verified envelope and parse once; this is the sole request object in the projection.
rowProjection.result: Inline parsed envelope.result with exactly protocol.resultFields; no implicit renaming or synthesized observation fields.
rowProjection.effects: Resolve result.effects descriptor using bundled relative path, verify its bytes/SHA256, then parse and inline with exactly protocol.effectsFields. It is not a descriptor at mutation-pointer time.
rowProjection.binding: result/effects rowId and requestSha256 must match projected request and exact retained R. Request/result/effects are materialized only after verifying external object descriptors.
rowProjection.mutation: Pointers address this projection. For referenceRows/platform mutation, alter the backing retained request platform and rebuild R/envelope.
